decisions.reason: Reusing content and images in the Ridgehaven mockup does not change Harbor Valley site availability or master-site linkage during transition.
The accepted reuse applies to mockup content and images and does not establish any new SEO-preservation or migration behavior.
The supporting proposal retains the new logo and branding; reuse of legacy content and images does not modify the approved brand identity.
The proposal reiterates use of the competitor's layout and structure without changing the existing visual-layout requirement.
Mockup reuse of legacy content and images has no necessary effect on location-specific analytics or reporting isolation.
The source decision does not change selectable locations, selector placement, or location-routing behavior.
Reusing materials for a preview does not change booking placement, isolation, or Ridgehaven booking activation.
The source decision concerns mockup materials and does not alter separate payout or payment-account configuration.
Legacy content and image reuse does not affect Ridgehaven customer-database isolation.
The mockup-content decision does not change location-specific gift-card operations.
The accepted reuse of content and images does not alter membership isolation between locations.
The source decision does not identify or change any domain-to-website mapping.
